cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.20)
project(scpp_mysql_verification LANGUAGES CXX)
if(NOT SCPP_ROOT)
  message(FATAL_ERROR "SCPP_ROOT must identify the source checkout")
endif()
set(SCPP_WITH_MYSQLI ON CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(SCPP_ENABLE_MYSQLI_TESTS ON CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
add_subdirectory("${SCPP_ROOT}/runtime" runtime)
add_executable(mysql_fixture mysql_fixture.cpp)
target_link_libraries(mysql_fixture PRIVATE scpp_php_legacy scpp_lang_php scpp_runtime)
